title.en: What the Prestressed concrete outline cannot add to concrete pump rubber spring φ200
title.zh: 《Prestressed concrete》的大纲不能给concrete pump rubber spring φ200加数字

description.en: Section titles come from Prestressed concrete; the concrete pump rubber spring φ200 figures stay the printed ones. The φ200 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Prestressed concrete》，concrete pump rubber spring φ200的数字仍是已印数字。φ200 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

h1.en: Prestressed concrete headings over the concrete pump rubber spring φ200 catalogue line
h1.zh: 《Prestressed concrete》的标题盖在concrete pump rubber spring φ200的目录行上

directAnswer.en: The short answer for concrete pump rubber spring φ200 uses the cells Xingtai already printed. Prestressed concrete is the outline those cells are filed under. The φ200 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ200的简答只用邢台已经印出的格子。《Prestressed concrete》是这些格子所依的大纲。 φ200 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: “Pre-tensioned concrete” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ200 row is rubber and polyurethane. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ200, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “来源章节：Pre-tensioned concrete”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ200 这一行是橡胶和聚氨酯。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ200，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Post-tensioned concrete”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ200, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. The φ200 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Post-tensioned concrete”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ200 和个数。 φ200 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Tendon durability and corrosion protection

body.en: “Tendon durability and corrosion protection” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. The heading stops there.
body.zh: “来源章节：Tendon durability and corrosion protection”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 标题到此为止。

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Applications”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页在“用途”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Design agencies and regulations

body.en: The source page divides this subject at “Design agencies and regulations”. The words under that heading, in this note, stay inside the Xingtai wording already printed. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 橡胶弹簧 page plus this size and the quantity. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete
body.zh: 来源页在“来源章节：Design agencies and regulations”处分开叙述。这一节沿用该标题，底下只重复邢台已经印出的说法。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明橡胶弹簧这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prestressed_concrete

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。

answer.zh: 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
